name: Augustus
description: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament

points: There went out a decree from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed. You thought taxation started with America; it started with Rome. Everything America does is based on ancient Rome.
Luke 2:1 names Caesar Augustus; Luke 3:1 names Tiberius. These are the feathers we are reading about in Esdras. When you read the four gospels, Tiberius is the Caesar of the time Christ was an adult.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
